BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced on May 1, 2026, that it purchased 644,527 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of its share buyback program. The purchases occurred at prices ranging from 877.6000 pence to 893.6000 pence per share, with a volume-weighted average price of 884.9643 pence. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 01 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 1 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 644,527 Highest price paid per share: 893.6000 Lowest price paid per share: 877.6000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 884.9643 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
